name: bioar-offline
description: BioAR — Atlas de Anatomia 3D educacional, empacotado para Android e funcionamento offline.

scripts.dev: node scripts/prepare-offline.mjs && node scripts/copy-vendor.mjs && vite .offline-build --config vite.config.js --host 0.0.0.0
scripts.build: node scripts/prepare-offline.mjs && node scripts/copy-vendor.mjs && vite build .offline-build --config vite.config.js
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && cap sync android && node scripts/prepare-android.mjs
scripts.android:apk: npm run build && cap sync android && node scripts/prepare-android.mjs && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
